purpose: Audit whether the current primary short-horizon account evidence is concentrated in repeated same-stock episodes or explained by execution, adjustment, corporate-action, industry, year, or fold anomalies before changing models or portfolio rules.

scenarios.primary: Top10 stress with repeated same-symbol cohorts allowed
scenarios.control: Top10 stress with repeated same-symbol cohorts forbidden

episode_contract.primary: For a symbol, merge a next trade when its entry index is no later than the running maximum exit index.
episode_contract.sensitivity: Also merge a next trade when its entry index is one trading day after the running maximum exit index.
